svg.title: Searching an IVF-PQ index: choosing lists and scoring PQ codes by table lookup
svg.desc: 1. q is compared with all 10,000 centroids and only the nprobe nearest inverted lists are searched. 2. For each probed list, the residual r = q − c is cut into 64 parts of 18 dimensions, and a table T holds the distance from each part to each of its subspace's 256 codewords. 3. Each list entry is one image: its sample ID and one code per part. Each code picks the cell in its column of T, and the 64 picked values add up to the entry's approximate distance d, so no vector is decoded. 4. Entries from all probed lists are ranked by d and the k smallest are returned as candidates. All numbers and sample IDs are illustrative.

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Heiti SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
